description: A copy of the r-fmt-2b-w-accdb fixture (123 pages; page 122, Au4's old data page, is the only free page inside the file). Au1: tdef 107, usage maps 108, PK root 109, ten rows (IDs 1-10, 21-23 bytes) on data page 110. One shared session opens a dynaset on SELECT * FROM Au1 ORDER BY ID and runs Delete then MoveNext ten times; after each Delete and a 1.5 s pause the pages are read with the database open. Then the recordset closes (pages read), the database closes (pages read). Asks at which Delete, and at which point (statement, write-behind, recordset close, Close), page 110 is freed. Each read keeps page 0 bytes 3584-3591 and pages 1, 107, 108, 109, 110, 122; after Close every page's hash too.
